subject: Request: one-time sandbox concession for HelioHealth pilot
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.inference, chloe_martin@redwood.inference
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.inference
Date: Wed, 15 Feb 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: one-time sandbox concession for HelioHealth pilot

Team —

Quick context: HelioHealth (busy payer-side pilot) is 3 weeks into a 30-day PLG pilot. Usage spiked after the integration work completed and they’re hitting token limits; the product fit looks strong (two workflows we instrumented returned very high signal). They’ve asked for an extension plus additional “free” sandbox credits to finish two critical integrations and run a short A/B on throughput before procurement.

Why this deviates from standard PLG limits:
- Standard: 30-day sandbox/credits capped at $5k.
- Ask: extend to 60 days and increase credits to $25k (one-off).

Why I’m asking for executive concession: HelioHealth is in advanced discussions with a payer consortium and has a clear path to a multi-year Dedicated commitment if the A/B shows prevalence edge. The expected deal size if conversion happens is $450k ARR in year 1 with predictable expansion. We can tie the concession to a signed Letter of Intent / PO by the end of the 60-day window.

Request: please approve escalation to exec for a one-time sandbox concession (60 days, $25k credits) with the following conditions:
- Addendum limiting credits to sandbox (no production tokens)
- Usage caps and telemetry access for our SREs
- PO or LOI from HelioHealth by day 45 of the extension

I’ve attached the updated proposal and a draft addendum for legal to review (HelioHealth_Pilot_Proposal_v3.pdf).

Next steps I propose: Laura to confirm commercial path + region, Chloe to do quick redline, Jonas to provide CRO-level easement if green. If we get sign-off today I’ll loop the customer and get a counter-signed LOI.

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior Sales Lead, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: HelioHealth_Pilot_Proposal_v3.pdf (proposal, 6 pages)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.inference
Cc: chloe_martin@redwood.inference, jonas_weber@redwood.inference
Date: Thu, 16 Feb 2028 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: one-time sandbox concession for HelioHealth pilot

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear summary. Commercial take: I’m sympathetic — HelioHealth is in the target vertical and the ARR upside looks real. Recommend we structure this as a conditional concession: 60-day extension + $25k sandbox credits, contingent on a signed LOI/PO and a one-time exec sign-off to make it nonprecedential.

I’ll escalate to Jonas for CRO sign-off. Chloe, can you turn the attached draft into a very short addendum (2–3 clauses): scope of credits, usage caps, telemetry and rollback triggers? We should also add a clause limiting any SLA or indemnity exposure.

If Jonas is good we can offer this by EOD to the customer and ask for a PO within 45 days.

Laura
Laura Bennett | Head of Deal Desk
Redwood Inference

Attachment: internal_notes.txt (3 bullets)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.inference>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.inference, marissa_cole@redwood.inference
Cc: chloe_martin@redwood.inference
Date: Fri, 17 Feb 2028 08:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: one-time sandbox concession for HelioHealth pilot

Laura / Marissa —

I’m comfortable approving the concession with the following firm conditions:
1) 60-day extension from acceptance date; $25k cap; credits limited to non-production sandbox environments.
2) HelioHealth must provide a signed LOI or PO committing to procurement review by day 45; if not received we automatically terminate credits and revert to standard limits.
3) Legal must sign off on the addendum to ensure no change to SLA or indemnity terms.

Chloe — please prepare the addendum and redline. I’ll sign the approval email once the addendum text is finalized.

Jonas
Jonas Weber | VP Sales
Redwood Inference

Note: marking this as an exceptional, nonprecedential concession. Keep deal record HL-472 updated in HubSpot and record justification.
